summary.en: England beat 10-man Czech Republic 2-0 away in Nations League action. Anthony Gordon opened the scoring from a Trent Alexander-Arnold assist before Harry Kane sealed the win. Head coach Thomas Tuchel singled out Alexander-Arnold for praise.

summary.zh_hans: 英格兰在欧洲国家联赛客场2:0击败十人应战的捷克。安东尼·戈登接应阿诺德助攻先开纪录，凯恩随后锁定胜局。主帅图赫尔赛后特别盛赞阿诺德的表现。

summary.en: Hong Kong track cyclists Iu Chun-ho and To Tsz-hei bounced back from round-of-32 defeats through the repechage to reach the men's individual sprint round of 16 at the Nagoya Asian Games. In the women's keirin, Yeung Cho-yiu qualified directly for the semifinals while Ng Sze-wing advanced via the repechage.
summary.zh_hant: 名古屋亞運場地單車賽事，港隊翁浚皓（資格賽9.948秒第11）與杜棹熙（9.996秒第13）在男子爭先賽1/16決賽落敗後，經復活賽「死而後生」晉級1/8決賽。女子競輪賽方面，楊礎搖初賽小組第二直接晉級準決賽，吳思穎則在復活賽小組第一晉級。
summary.zh_hans: 名古屋亚运场地单车赛事，港队翁浚皓（资格赛9.948秒第11）与杜棹熙（9.996秒第13）在男子争先赛1/16决赛落败后，经复活赛“死而后生”晋级1/8决赛。女子竞轮赛方面，杨础摇初赛小组第二直接晋级半决赛，吴思颖则在复活赛小组第一晋级。

summary.en: China's team of Chen Jinfeng, Liu Guoyi, Shi Junhao and Chen Yujie won the Asian Games athletics 4x100m mixed relay gold in Nagoya. The same report also notes Wu Hongjiao's women's 800m gold and Zhang Jiale's women's hammer gold.

summary.en: Clippers head coach Tyronn Lue confirmed that starting spots will be contested in training camp, saying his priority is finding the most compatible five-man combinations rather than simply picking the most talented individuals.

summary.zh_hant: 快艇主帥泰倫盧確認訓練營將競逐正選位置，並表示排陣重點係球員組合嘅適配性，而唔係只挑個人能力最強嘅球員。

summary.en: Hong Kong's men's squash team beat Qatar 2-0 in the team quarterfinals at the Nagoya Asian Games to advance to the semifinals, guaranteeing Hong Kong at least one medal. The rolling report also tracks the day's golf, cycling, esports and diving action.

summary.en: Clippers guard Darius Garland said after training that the team has been working together for at least two to three months and is building strong chemistry and competitiveness. Garland believes the Clippers will surprise people in the new season.

summary.zh_hant: 快艇後衛加蘭在訓練後表示，全隊已經一齊操練至少兩至三個月，默契同競爭性正在形成。佢相信快艇新賽季會有令人驚喜嘅表現。

title.en: Garland: Clippers Have Built Real Chemistry, Will Surprise People

summary.en: Lakers star Luka Doncic praised teammate Walker Kessler after training, saying the 7-foot-2 center's size stretches the floor on both offense and defense. Doncic added that Kessler's presence lets teammates feed him lobs whenever defenders collapse.

summary.en: Chelsea announced on Monday the signing of 20-year-old defensive midfielder Leo Black through 2028 after a successful trial. The versatile England youth international can play full-back and midfield, scored against Arsenal and Fulham in academy matches, and was shortlisted for September's Premier League 2 Player of the Month.
summary.zh_hans: 切尔西9月29日官方宣布，在试训期间表现出色后，正式签下20岁防守型中场莱奥-布莱克，合约至2028年。这名曾代表英格兰U18及U19梯队的多面手可胜任边后卫及中场，曾在青年队对阿森纳和富勒姆的比赛中进球，并入选9月英超青年联赛月度最佳球员候选。
summary.zh_hant: 車路士9月29日官方宣布，在試訓期間表現出色後，正式簽下20歲防守型中場萊奧-布萊克，合約至2028年。這名曾代表英格蘭U18及U19梯隊的多面手可勝任邊後衛及中場，曾在青年隊對阿森納和富勒姆的比賽中入球，並入選9月英超青年聯賽月度最佳球員候選。

title.en: Chelsea Sign 20-Year-Old England Midfielder Leo Black Through 2028

source_url: https://www.hk01.com/即時體育/60395028/英超-曼城違反聯賽財務規則指控全成立-曼城-將提上訴

summary.en: The Premier League announced on Monday that an independent commission found Manchester City guilty of all charges of serious breaches of financial rules between the 2009/10 and 2017/18 seasons, plus three of four non-cooperation charges. CEO Richard Masters called it the most significant case in Premier League history; City deny wrongdoing and must appeal by October 2.
summary.zh_hans: 英超赛会9月29日宣布，独立委员会裁定曼城在2009/10至2017/18九个赛季涉嫌严重违反联赛财务规则的全部指控成立，另有三项不配合调查指控成立。行政总裁马斯达斯形容此为「英超史上最重大的案件」；曼城否认不当行为，表明将提上诉，限期为10月2日。
summary.zh_hant: 英超賽會9月29日宣布，獨立委員會裁定曼城在2009/10至2017/18九個球季涉嫌嚴重違反聯賽財務規則的全部指控成立，另有三項不配合調查指控成立。行政總裁馬斯達斯形容此為「英超史上最重大的案件」；曼城否認不當行為，表明將提上訴，限期為10月2日。

title.en: Man City Found Guilty of All Premier League Financial Charges, Club to Appeal
